name: dsh-wait-subagent
description: Active wait + liveness status for background continuable subagents in DeepSeek Harness: registers four model-facing tools — wait_subagent (blocks until settle, returns stop reason + closing message; timeout carries activity diagnostics), get_subagent_status (non-blocking liveness probe: running vs stalled, last activity age, recent output), wait_some_subagent (first-of-N settlement for parallel fan-out harvesting), and wait_every_subagent (barrier: blocks until every listed child has settled, returns per-child results + failed list). dsh-wait-subagent：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台 continuable 子代理的主动等待与活性状态——wait_subagent 阻塞至收尾返回停止原因与收尾消息（超时附带活动诊断）、get_subagent_status 非阻塞探活（进行中/停滞判定+最近输出）、wait_some_subagent 等待首个收尾、wait_every_subagent 屏障式等待全部收尾（逐个结果+失败清单），补齐后台子代理只能被动等通知的缺口。
author: johnnren
